sql.financier.getActive: SELECT id, name, submission_method, archived, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id FROM brs.financier WHERE archived IS NOT TRUE ORDER BY name
sql.financier.update: UPDATE brs.financier SET name = :name, submission_method = :submissionMethod, archived = :archived, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
